title: 차수피벗 업체 분배수량 변경 계약
policyBoundaries: This contract covers week-pivot, adjust, paste-order distribution, and explicit farm-distribution only.
The separate estimate-additional-product contract intentionally continues to require a FarmKey; this optional-farm rule does not relax that workflow.

farmAssignmentPolicy.omitted: preserve ShipmentFarm including zero rows; farm assignment is optional for both a new ShipmentDetail and an existing ShipmentDetail with no ShipmentFarm rows
farmAssignmentPolicy.explicit: replace with submitted valid candidates; assignment total must equal the post-change ShipmentDetail.OutQuantity
farmAssignmentPolicy.reason: FormShipmentDistribution.btnSave_Click saves ShipmentDetail first and inserts ShipmentFarm only for modified farm-grid rows whose FarmKey is valid. It does not reject an empty or FarmKey=0 farm grid.

actions.name: ADD_WITHOUT_ACTIVE_ORDER
actions.stockOverride: never automatic; explicit user confirmation only

pasteMixedBatchPolicy.executionOrder: stable CANCEL phase first, then stable ADD phase
pasteMixedBatchPolicy.selectionModel: actions come from the pasted analysis; users do not build a separate multi-selection
pasteMixedBatchPolicy.addApiPolicy: reuse /api/shipment/adjust with type=ADD and the existing combined order+shipment policy
pasteMixedBatchPolicy.failurePolicy: preserve existing per-row results; continue through both phases and retry only failed ProdKey+type keys so successful rows are not applied twice

sideEffects.orderDetail: preserve when active shipment exists; decrease only when no active shipment exists
sideEffects.shipmentDetail: decrease when active shipment exists; otherwise preserve and never create

sideEffects.shipmentDateAndFarm: reuse existing adjust synchronization; farm assignment remains optional when omitted

crossYearFixture.description: 2025와 2026에 같은 OrderWeek·CustKey·ProdKey가 있을 때 2026 요청은 2026 행만 읽고 쓴다. stock-status view=pivot도 OrderMaster를 선택 연도로 제한하고 ShipmentMaster를 OrderYear+OrderWeek+CustKey로 결합한다.
